# عبدالله لتكييف الهواء — Abdullah Air Conditioning

> AC, refrigerator, and washing machine repair company serving all of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Same-day and 24/7 emergency service, typical technician arrival within 30 minutes, written 1-year warranty on installations and 90-day warranty on repairs. Founded 2009.

Abdullah Air Conditioning (عبدالله لتكييف الهواء) is a licensed HVAC and home-appliance repair business based in Al-Quds district, Riyadh (حي القدس، الرياض 13214). It repairs, installs, and cleans split and central air conditioners, and repairs washing machines and refrigerators, for all major brands (LG, Samsung, Gree, Daikin, Carrier, Midea, Hitachi) across all Riyadh neighborhoods.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +966 55 292 5939
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 7:00–22:00; emergency service 24/7 every day including holidays
- Address: 8208 Prince Mohammed bin Faisal bin Turki Rd, Al-Quds District, Riyadh 13214, Saudi Arabia
- Website: https://www.abdullahairconditioning.com/

## Core services
- AC repair (split & central) — https://www.abdullahairconditioning.com/services
- AC installation and removal
- AC deep cleaning (chemical wash)
- AC gas refill / freon recharge (R32, R410A, R22)
- Washing machine repair (all brands)
- Refrigerator / freezer repair
- 24/7 emergency AC and appliance repair

## Typical pricing (starting prices, final price confirmed after diagnosis)
- Diagnostic/inspection visit: 50–100 SAR (waived if repair proceeds)
- General repair (filter, drainage, sensor): from 150 SAR
- Gas refill R32: from 150 SAR; R410A: from 180 SAR; R22: from 300 SAR
- Leak repair: 200–600 SAR
- Chemical AC cleaning: from 120 SAR
- Control board (PCB) repair: 350–600 SAR
- Compressor repair: from 900 SAR; full compressor/unit replacement: from ~1,800 SAR (1.5-ton)
- No extra charge for night, weekend, or holiday emergency calls

## Service area
All Riyadh districts, including: الملقا (Al Malqa), الياسمين (Al Yasmin), النزهة (Al Nuzha), القدس (Al Quds), الروضة (Al Rawdah), العليا (Al Olaya), الملك فهد (King Fahd), حطين (Hittin), العقيق (Al Aqiq), الغدير (Al Ghadir), الشفا (Ash Shifa), المالز (Al Malaz).
